proposal.summary: IBM Financial Transaction Manager 3.2.0 through 3.2.7 allows a remote attacker to use directory traversal via specially-crafted URL requests containing '/../' to view arbitrary files on the system.
proposal.cwe_quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

AV.quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

C.quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vendor advisory or IBM X-Force record for 192953 to confirm affected components, reproduction steps, and vendor mitigation or patch; if confirmed, block or filter traversal sequences at webserver/proxy and apply vendor patches.

evidence_quotes.claim: Directory traversal allows viewing arbitrary files
evidence_quotes.quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.
IBM Financial Transaction Manager 3.2.0 through 3.2.7 could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system.
